title: check: migratedFrom format and duplicate-fingerprint flag (D3)
description: Core git-vouch change: validate migratedFrom = 'openpgp4fpr:' + 40 uppercase/lowercase hex; flag (report, per D3) any fingerprint claimed by more than one handle. String comparison only; git-vouch never runs gpg.
acceptance_criteria: Tests: bad format rejected; two handles with one fingerprint both flagged; check output names both.
